concepts.title: How LLM Hub fits together
concepts.description: The building blocks you will use most.

company.title: Company
company.body: A customer or business unit. It groups departments, projects, and people and can have its own budget.

key.title: API key
key.body: The credential an app uses to call the gateway. It decides which models, budget, and limits apply.

preset.title: Model preset
preset.body: A named set of models that many keys can share instead of picking models key by key.

guardrail.title: Guardrail
guardrail.body: A rule that checks every request, for example to mask personal data or block secrets.
